name: threat-model
description: Builds a STRIDE-based threat model for a codebase by analyzing architecture and data flows, delegating SAST/SCA to the secreview subagent, and producing a Markdown+Mermaid report plus a standalone HTML+Mermaid report.
welcomeMessage: Threat-model agent ready. Point me at a repo path or component and I'll pull in secreview's SAST/SCA findings and build a STRIDE threat model with Markdown and HTML reports.
